files.content: Displays a file or image attachment — media, name, metadata, upload state, and optional actions. Built on the [shadcn Attachment](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/attachment) primitives (`Attachment`, `AttachmentMedia`, `AttachmentContent`, `AttachmentTitle`, `AttachmentDescription`, `AttachmentActions`, `AttachmentAction`, `AttachmentTrigger`). Use it in chat composers, message threads, and upload lists — typically inside a `shad/message` footer, or grouped with `shad/attachment-group`. ## Media - **`icon`** — a registered icon name rendered in a rounded icon badge. - **`imageSrc`** / **`imageAlt`** — renders an `` preview instead; takes precedence over `icon`. ## Upload state `state`: `"idle"` | `"uploading"` | `"processing"` | `"error"` | `"done"` (default). `"uploading"` / `"processing"` shimmer the title; `"error"` tints the border/media red — keep the failure reason in `description` so the state isn't conveyed by color alone. ## Actions `actions` is a list of icon-only buttons (e.g. remove, download). Each requires an `ariaLabel` describing the action and its target. Clicking one fires `onActionClicked` with `{id, action}`. ## Trigger Set `triggerAriaLabel` to make the whole card clickable/keyboard-activatable (fires `onTriggered`) while keeping the action buttons independently clickable. ## Group Use `shad/attachment-group` to lay out multiple attachments in a horizontally scrollable, snapping row.
